Third-party files (MIT unless noted; licences next to each in its folder):
- qrcode.mjs: qrcode-generator 2.0.4 by Kazuhiko Arase (https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator)
- JsBarcode.all.min.js: JsBarcode 3.12.3 by Johan Lindell (https://github.com/lindell/JsBarcode)
- html-to-image.js: html-to-image 1.11.13 by bubkoo (https://github.com/bubkoo/html-to-image), dist/html-to-image.js unchanged
- tesseract/: Tesseract.js 5.1.1 + tesseract.js-core 5.1.1 (Apache-2.0) and the English model (tesseract.js-data eng, 4.0.0_best_int): reads bill photos on the phone (public/billocr.js).
- pdfjs/: pdf.js (pdfjs-dist 4.10.38, Apache-2.0): reads the text of PDF bills on the phone.
